why.t01: Both seeds are clean walks with t01's boy and one edge-on flat bat, and in both the cow never turns its head. Seed 7 does the camera move the prompt asks for (it trucks back down the lane in front of him), starts with no pop and is the livelier take. Seed 21's camera stays put while he walks up to the lens, and his face rounds a little more. Seed 21 is a usable backup. The earlier verdict (review_skyreels.json) kept Wan S01_a for S01; t01_s7 has none of the round-1 SkyReels faults (the start pop, the over-coloured cow) and is longer (4.04 s against 3.375 s), so the hold in the 5.5 s shot is shorter. The owner chooses between the two.
why.t02: Seed 21 pushes in slowly as asked, keeps the bat in frame for all 4 s, shows the grip tightening and the slow smile, and keeps t02's face with only mild rounding at the end. Seed 7's push-in overshoots into an extreme close-up: the fist is gone by about 2.4 s, the bat by about 3.3 s, and the face is redrawn rounder and broader from 2.9 s. Seed 7 is a backup only with clip_cut_end 1.15.
why.t04: Seed 7 drifts gently towards the window as asked and nothing in it appears or vanishes. Seed 21 is nearly still and has a white, ball-like blob flying across the stadium in the window at 1.58-2.38 s. Neither shows a visible flicker of the dream stadium or a shimmer of the bulb. Seed 21 is not a good backup.
why.p01: Seed 21 is the only usable take: a forward and upward camera move over the ground to a waving crowd, with soft haze. Seed 7 fails: a smoke storm from 0.33 s and football-like box markings on the ground from 1.0 s.

second_takes: Each of the four pictures is used by one shot only (plan.json shots 1-4 and motion_shots.json S01-S04), so no picture needs a second take for a second shot. Usable backups: t01_s21 (whole); t02_s7 (only with clip_cut_end 1.15). Not usable: t04_s21 (the white blob) and p01_s7.
both_failed: None. Every picture has at least one usable take.

failures_and_causes.p01_s7: Likely cause: the prompt's 'haze drifts' and 'floodlights flare', with no negative (fast mode runs with guidance 1 and an empty negative), let this seed draw billowing smoke. 'The camera rises slowly over the ground' brings the plain ground in p01 close to the camera, and the model fills it with the field lines it expects in a stadium; p01 has no creases or boundary to anchor a cricket ground (its centre line was painted out). The same cause, more mildly, gives seed 21's sidelines.
failures_and_causes.t02_s7: The seed, not the picture: the same prompt gave seed 21 a slow push. With 'close-up' and 'the camera pushes in', seed 7 kept pushing, and the face, redrawn at three times its size, lost t02's proportions. Nothing in fast mode limits how far a push goes.
failures_and_causes.t04_s21: Likely cause: 'a dreamlike stadium ... flickers' asks for something to change in the window. This seed made a white ball-like object fly over the stands, and the empty negative cannot exclude 'ball' as S03's Wan negative does.

timing: All clips are 4.04 s. S01 is 5.5 s (a hold of about 1.5 s), S02 4.2 s (0.2 s), S03 4.0 s (it fits), S04 5.9 s (about 1.9 s, on p01_s21's dimmer stands frame). Holds must be moving holds (ANIME_CRAFT.md section 9).
not_checked: Playback at full speed by eye (judged from frames, sheets, strips and measurements); the clips after lyric_video.py (scaling to 1920x1080, timing on twos or threes, the moving hold); whether the Space really ran the I2V model and the lightx2v LoRA (only the log says so). The cow's head turn and the drifting dust were looked for and not seen; a flicker in t04 was measured and not found. Nothing was copied into clips_raw or plan.json, and nothing was committed.
overall: Three of the four pictures got a clean take at the first try, and the fourth (t02) got one good take out of two. Picks: t01_s7, t02_s21, t04_s7, p01_s21, all minor. They still need the owner's yes (test-batch rule). One of the two seeds failed for t02, t04 and p01, so keep making two seeds per picture.
